G: the finite undirected graph in the theorem
A: the union of the even-depth classes over all connected components
B: the union of the odd-depth classes over all connected components
C: an arbitrary connected component of G
r: the chosen root vertex of T
W: an arbitrary closed walk used in the internal lemma
m: the length of an arbitrary cycle
v_i: the vertex reached after i edges in the displayed cycle traversal
i: an index of a repeated vertex in W
j: a later index of the same repeated vertex in W
P: the unique path in T from x to y
Q: the unique path in T from x to y
|P|: the number of edges in the walk P
|Q|: the number of edges in the walk Q
u: one endpoint of the edge considered in the reverse implication
X: one class of the bipartition; in the reverse implication, the set of vertices at even root-distance in their components
Y: the other class of the bipartition; in the reverse implication, the set of vertices at odd root-distance in their components
H: an arbitrary connected component of G
r_H: the chosen root vertex of H
x: one endpoint of an arbitrary edge under consideration
y: the other endpoint of that edge
r_C: the chosen root vertex of T_C
d_C(v): the number of edges on the unique T_C-path from r_C to v
p(v): the chosen neighbor of a nonroot vertex v whose d_C-value is one smaller
w: a maximum-distance vertex on a hypothetical cycle in T_H
z: the common parent-chain vertex of x and y with largest d_H-value
d(v): the number of edges in the unique path in T from r to v
d: the depth function, where d(x) is the length of the unique T-path from r to x
A_H: the vertices of H at even depth in T
B_H: the vertices of H at odd depth in T
d_H(x): the shortest-path distance in H from r_H to a vertex x
p_H(x): the chosen parent of a non-root vertex x, one distance level nearer r_H
T_H: the rooted spanning tree of H formed by the parent edges
k: the common value d_H(x)=d_H(y) in the contradiction argument
V(C): the vertex set of the connected component C
A_C: the vertices of C whose T_C-depth from r_C is even
B_C: the vertices of C whose T_C-depth from r_C is odd
